title: Custom Skirmish Trails: trail settings
description: Settings for one skirmish trail as a whole. Every entry is optional; a missing or empty entry keeps the game's own value. Relative file paths are taken from the folder of this file.

colours.description: Players by colour: red is you (slot 1); orange, yellow, blue, black, purple, lightblue and green are slots 2-8.

condition.description: An object with one key, the condition's type. A type or value this version doesn't know is reported in the log and never holds.

won.description: Holds once one win of the mission met every other key.

mission.description: The node id that was won.

lords_alive.description: These players' lords were alive at that win.

players_alive.description: These players were still in the game at that win: lord alive and keep standing.

any.description: Holds when one of the conditions holds.

$schema.description: Optional schema path or URL for editor validation and hover help.

trail_type.description: Use First, Warchest or Extreme to restrict this file to that trail, or omit to use the trail selected in the UCP GUI.

trail_title.description: Title under the trail button, with the game's title used if omitted and a language file able to override it.

trail_summary.description: Summary under the trail title, wrapping after 540 pixels; omission keeps the game's text and a language file can override it.

mission_locked_text.description: Briefing text shown before a dated scenario opens, with {date} replaced by its opening date; omission keeps the normal briefing unless translated.

trail_id.description: Names the files that keep this trail's progress, passed missions and results (progress-<trail_id>.txt and so on, in the module's user data folder), apart from the game's own progress and every other trail_id. Omission names them by the trail and keeps the game's own progress.

chickens.description: Total skip tokens of the trail, from 0 to 2147483647 or unlimited; omission keeps the game's budget.

starting_year.description: The year the trail's first mission starts in. The game uses 1100 for the first trail and 1130 for the Warchest and the Extreme trail.

trail_visuals.description: Pictures that replace the game's own for this trail.

trail_button_idle.description: Picture path for the trail button at rest, such as a .png; omission keeps the game's button.

trail_button_highlighted.description: Picture path for the trail button under the mouse, such as a .png; omission keeps the game's button.

trail_background.description: Trail background path at the game's original size (.tgx, .png, .jpg, .bmp or .gif); omission keeps the game's background.

trail_icon_sheet.description: Path to a .gm1 sheet of the missions' icon pictures, laid out as skirmish_trail_icons.gm1: exactly its 130 pictures of 100 x 100 and its GM1 type, the only layout gmResourceModifier's ReserveGm accepts; omission keeps the game's flags.

trail_mission_positions.description: One button position per mission on the 800 x 600 trail screen (up to 50 for First or 30 for Warchest and Extreme); omission keeps the game's positions. Not used with a route of files, whose nodes have the positions.

x.description: Required horizontal button coordinate in pixels (0-800).

y.description: Required vertical button coordinate in pixels (0-600).

trail_route.description: The trail's missions as nodes keyed by an id of your own (letters, digits, _ and -). Nodes require other nodes, so the trail can branch into parallel paths and join again, and can have side missions. A node names its mission by file and position (a route of files: Trails orders the rows itself, the end last) or by mission number (a route by number); one route uses one of the two. Side missions and parallel paths need door pictures. Omit to play the missions in their order.

file.description: A route of files: this node's mission file (format 1, mission.schema.json), relative to this file. Every node of the route then has a file and a position.

position.description: A route of files: the node's button on the 800 x 600 trail screen.

mission.description: A route by number: the mission's number in the trail's mission data, its mission file's number (or csv line). Missions the route doesn't name are main missions.

kind.description: main (the default) or side. A side mission doesn't move the trail on, can't be skipped with a chicken and can't be the end.

end.description: true for the node whose win finishes the trail; nothing may require it. Without it the end is the one main node no other node requires (a route by number: its last mission).

requires.description: Node ids that must all be passed first. A node is passed once it is won, a main node also when a chicken skipped it. In a route by number a main mission without requires and requires_any follows the main mission before it.

requires_any.description: Node ids of which at least one must be passed first.

unlock.description: The node opens only once this condition holds.

reward.description: Given once, at the node's first win (not at a skip with a chicken).

chickens.description: More chickens on this trail, on top of its chickens budget (or the game's 3); no change with unlimited.

trail_missions.description: Synchronizes a mission JSON folder and its matching CSV at game start; omission leaves mission selection to the UCP GUI.

base_name.description: Required path to both the mission folder and the CSV, written without the .csv suffix.

data_mode.description: What the game loads. json_folder: the mission files. csv (the default): the CSV. automatic: per mission the newer one, with CSV winning ties. Neither is written.

trail_text_files.description: Folder of <language>.json files or an object mapping languages to file paths; omission keeps the original text. See trail-language.schema.json for the file format.

ai_character_mapping.description: Unique AI aliases for mission files and CSV, with omitted aliases keeping the original keys and other AI keys reserved.
